product.name: AMH Test
product.description: A home-based blood test measuring Anti-Müllerian Hormone to assess ovarian reserve and fertility potential.

product.name: Perimenopause Test
product.description: An at-home blood test measuring key hormones to identify hormonal changes during the transition to menopause.

product.name: STD Test - 9 Pathogens
product.description: A discreet home testing kit for screening nine common sexually transmitted diseases.

product.name: STD Test - 13 Pathogens
product.description: A home testing kit for comprehensive screening of thirteen sexually transmitted infections.

product.name: Egg Freezing Services
product.description: A fertility preservation service enabling women to freeze eggs for future use through clinical egg retrieval and storage.

product.name: Telehealth Consultations
product.description: Virtual appointments with fertility, perimenopause, sexual health, and hormonal health specialists for personalized care.
